reference: Hou R, Tang S, Jin W. An Adaptive Machine Learning Triage Framework for Predicting Alzheimer's Disease Progression. ML4H Findings. 2025. arXiv:2511.06681.
method_used: Basic/advanced models, cross-fitted triage targets and capacity-matched risk, uncertainty and random baselines.
difference: Our endpoints are concurrent status or differential diagnosis, not ADNI two-year progression. Their clinical effect and AUROC cannot be compared directly with ours.

reference: Mlinarič T, Van Den Kerchove A, Barinaga ZI, Van Hulle MM. EEG-based classification of Alzheimer's disease and frontotemporal dementia using functional connectivity. Scientific Reports. 2026;16:4903. Corrected May 2026.
method_used: Motivates band-specific second-order coupling and covariance geometry as a complementary EEG representation.
difference: We implement trace-normalized log-covariance features with training-only PCA, not FgMDM or the published stacked classifier. Their difficult AD/FTD results caution against assuming richer representations must win.

reference: Shen L, Tong W, Zhao Y, Wu B, Zhang P, Kan J. Explainable machine learning for Alzheimer's disease characterization using small-sample EEG data. Frontiers in Aging Neuroscience. 2026;18:1900857.
method_used: Motivates spectral ratios and complexity summaries in compact patient-level models.
difference: Their task is AD versus healthy controls and their reported design is non-nested. Our AD/FTD feature family is fixed and classifier selection stays inside outer training folds; no direct numerical comparison.

reference: Wang H, Madarasingha C, Mahmud R, Krishna A, Takechi R. Leakage-Safe Empirical Benchmarking of EEG-Based Machine Learning Pipelines for Dementia Classification. 2026. arXiv:2609.22092.
method_used: Supports multimodal EEG descriptors and participant-level validation as a serious baseline design.
difference: Preprint; bibliographic date fields are inconsistent across identifiers and source metadata, so no exact submission date is asserted. We do not reproduce its segmentation, augmentation, feature selection or claimed accuracy.

reference: Miltiadous A, et al. The AHEPA EEG benchmark setting the standard for machine learning in dementia diagnosis, a scoping review. Cognitive Neurodynamics. 2026;20:95.
method_used: Retain one row per person and all epochs of each person within the same fold.
difference: Development resampling on previously studied participants remains exploratory; patient isolation alone does not make it external validation.
